architecture.summary: Treat only the pinned WorkOS OAuth 400 organization_membership_not_found error during automatic expired-session refresh as the existing local signed-out result. Clear the Thermus cookie so a new sign-in can recover current identity and explicitly choose a retained workspace. Other errors and refresh refusal results keep their existing handling. Retryable outages and unrecognized thrown errors retain the cookie; existing terminal refusals still clear it. Explicit workspace-switch refusal still retains its session. No fail-open, automatic workspace choice, role/MFA/CSRF/acceptance change, provider write, removal receipt/replay change, storage/deployment change, new component, component edge, public module or declaration change. All 15 registry Mermaid views remain byte-identical; registry prose records the known terminal branch in the existing WorkOS owner. This restores the existing sign-in-required contract for a known provider refusal and changes sensitive session recovery within the approved architecture guarantees. Current-head independent human approval remains required.
